run_model_benchmark: run a benchmark for a PyTorch model like resnet18 in eval or train mode with a given batch size
run_node_ordering: run node ordering optimization on a computation graph to reduce peak memory usage using the ILP solver
run_simulation: run a memory simulation on a computation graph with a given node ordering to estimate peak memory usage
run_rematerialization: run rematerialization planning to reduce memory usage by a target percentage and measure the runtime overhead
run_spilling: run spilling planning to reduce memory usage by swapping data and measure the estimated runtime overhead
